material_root_causes.requirement: Refreshing an active session keeps it usable for a further full window.
material_root_causes.trigger: an operator extends a session late in its original window
material_root_causes.consequence: an operator is signed out in the middle of active work

material_root_causes.requirement: Every refresh is recorded so an operator can reconstruct it later.
material_root_causes.trigger: an operator reads the log after several extensions
material_root_causes.consequence: the recorded history cannot distinguish one extension from another
equivalent_formulations: the recorded entry omits which moment the extension happened
